chunks: There is no god other than He, who gives life and causes death; your Lord and the Lord of your fathers of old.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's power over life and death in relation to our ancestors?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ad-Dukhan, this verse serves as a rhetorical climax to the narrative of the Pharaoh's denial, asserting Allah's absolute sovereignty over both existence and mortality. Shia exegetes often highlight the phrase 'Lord of your ancestors' to emphasize the continuity of Tawhid across generations, contrasting the eternal Lord with the transient idols of the past. This reinforces the concept that divine authority is not limited to the present but encompasses the entire lineage of humanity, from Adam to the current generation.
